mohammad_al_amin_mosque.name: Mohammad Al-Amin Mosque
mohammad_al_amin_mosque.hours: Open daily outside prayer times; check on the day
mohammad_al_amin_mosque.tip: The blue domes are best seen from Martyrs' Square. Women cover hair and shoulders; modest dress for men.

national_museum.name: National Museum of Beirut
national_museum.price_text: Small entry fee; check current price at the door
national_museum.hours: Closed Monday; Tue–Sun roughly 09:00–17:00, check on the day
national_museum.tip: Start on the ground floor for the sarcophagi, then the upper floor for the gold jewellery.

beit_beirut.name: Beit Beirut
beit_beirut.hours: Tue–Sun, afternoon hours; check on the day
beit_beirut.tip: The bullet-scarred facade is the exhibit. Allow time for the small displays on the civil war.

jeita_grotto.name: Jeita Grotto
jeita_grotto.price_text: Ticket fee; check current price on arrival. Cameras not allowed inside
jeita_grotto.hours: Closed Monday; roughly 09:00–17:00, check on the day
jeita_grotto.tip: You visit the lower cave by boat and the upper cave on foot. Bring a light jacket; it is cool inside.

our_lady_of_lebanon.name: Our Lady of Lebanon
our_lady_of_lebanon.price_text: Free entry; small fee for the cable car
our_lady_of_lebanon.hours: Basilica open daily; cable car hours vary, check on the day
our_lady_of_lebanon.tip: Ride the cable car up from Jounieh for the bay view, then walk to the statue.

byblos_citadel.name: Byblos Citadel
byblos_citadel.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
byblos_citadel.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–17:00, check on the day
byblos_citadel.tip: Combine with the old souk and harbour below. Wear shoes with grip for the ancient stones.
byblos_citadel.best: Morning, then lunch by the harbour

beiteddine_palace.name: Beiteddine Palace
beiteddine_palace.price_text: Entry fee; check current price at the gate
beiteddine_palace.hours: Tue–Sun, daytime hours; check on the day
beiteddine_palace.tip: The mosaic collection in the courtyard wings is the highlight. It is a long day trip from Beirut.

nijmeh_square.name: Nijmeh Square
nijmeh_square.tip: The old clock tower and parliament building frame the square. Walk here at dusk when the lights come on.

tabbouleh.name: Tabbouleh
tabbouleh.price_text: A few thousand LBP at a casual restaurant; more in upscale places
tabbouleh.hours: Served at most Lebanese restaurants, lunch and dinner
tabbouleh.tip: Order it as a mezze starter with fresh bread. It is heavy on parsley, light on bulgur.

martyrs_square.name: Martyrs' Square
martyrs_square.tip: The bullet-marked statue is the city's memory. Use it as the start of a Downtown walk.

corniche_beirut.name: Beirut Corniche
corniche_beirut.tip: Walk or jog west at sunset past the Pigeon Rocks. Locals fish and swim along the way.

pigeon_rocks.name: Pigeon Rocks (Raouche)
pigeon_rocks.tip: View from the Corniche path or take a short boat ride around the arch.

gemmayzeh_walk.name: Gemmayzeh street walk
gemmayzeh_walk.price_text: Free to walk; cafes and bars extra
gemmayzeh_walk.hours: Best in the evening; bars open late
gemmayzeh_walk.tip: Wander the side streets for old Lebanese houses, then pick a bar on Gouraud Street.

hamra_walk.name: Hamra Street and side lanes
hamra_walk.tip: Browse the bookshops and cafes, then eat at a small local bakery.

mezze_dinner.name: Lebanese mezze dinner
mezze_dinner.price_text: Varies widely; check the menu before ordering
mezze_dinner.hours: Most restaurants open evening; some also lunch
mezze_dinner.tip: Order a spread of small plates to share. Ask for the day's fresh fish if offered.

achrafieh_walk.name: Achrafieh old streets walk
achrafieh_walk.tip: Look up for the old stone houses and shutters. Stop for coffee at a small corner cafe.
